deletion_how: In-app SETTINGS → SAVE → ERASE MY DATA (also on the /privacy page), NEW HIVE for the live hive only, or uninstall / clear app storage.
notes: Save game is localStorage / app private storage only. Not uploaded. No ads, no analytics SDK. In-app purchases are processed by Google Play Billing; the app asks Play which heroes the player owns and caches that list on the device (nidus.owned.v1). With the purchase check off (default) nothing is sent to the developer. With it on, see if_purchase_check_on.

if_purchase_check_on.when: Only after ACK_URL is set in src/lib/nidus/support.ts (off by default).
if_purchase_check_on.declare: Financial info → Purchase history: collected, not shared, processed ephemerally, required, purpose App functionality.
if_purchase_check_on.why: The Google Play purchase token is sent to the game's own /api/ack endpoint so Google Play records the purchase as acknowledged. Nothing is stored.
